FILE: README.md
================================================
# Adventure

> Text adventures for walkers — a step-gated interactive fiction engine and
> authoring tool for Android.

**Status:** pre-alpha. Features, data formats, UI and public APIs may change
without notice. The repository is under active development.

## What is this?

Adventure is an Android app for people who enjoy text adventures (such as
*Fighting Fantasy* and similar gamebooks) and walking — and for authors who
want to write text quests. Chapters are unlocked by real-world steps counted
by the phone's step sensor (or Health Connect), so reading progress is tied
to physical activity.

Two primary audiences:

- **Authors** — write, edit and preview interactive adventures inside the app.
- **Developers** — extend the app, add features, integrate new step sources.

End users of the app find everything they need in the in-app UI; this README
and `docs/` are for authors and developers.

## Features (current)

- Adventure editor: scenes, choices, conditional branching, tags
  (health / items / journal), chapter ends with step gates, death scenes,
  initial player state.
- Reader with HUD (health, inventory, journal), save/resume progress, death
  handling (step back / restart chapter / restart adventure).
- Step counter: foreground service using `TYPE_STEP_COUNTER` plus optional
  Health Connect source; 30-day history; monotonic all-time counter.
- Utilities: validator, search, story statistics, map view, JSON
  import/export via the Storage Access Framework.
- Adjustable font size and custom fonts, in-app debug log viewer.

See [ROADMAP.md](./ROADMAP.md) for what is planned.

## Quick start (developers)

Requirements:

- Android Studio (latest stable)
- JDK 21 (the project's Gradle toolchain)
- Android device or emulator with `minSdk 26`

Build and run:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/andrey-ufo/Adventure.git
cd Adventure
./gradlew :app:assembleDebug
```

On first launch the app asks you to choose a folder (via the Storage Access
Framework). Adventure creates two sub-folders inside it:

- `Adventures/` — library of finished works
- `NewAdventures/` — drafts

and a few service files (`progress.json`, `step_history.json`,
`debug_log.txt`) at the root of the chosen folder.

## Documentation

Full documentation lives in [`docs/`](./docs/index.md). Start there.

- **For authors** — [Authoring guide](./docs/authoring-guide.md)
- **For developers** — [Getting started](./docs/getting-started.md),
  [Architecture overview](./docs/architecture.md)
- **Documentation rules** — [docs/documentation-rules.md](./docs/documentation-rules.md)

## Project structure (high level)

- `app/src/main/java/com/myapp/adventure/` — application code
  - `data/` — domain models (Adventure, Scene, Choice, Tag, …) and editor models
  - `service/` — `StepCounterService` (foreground sensor service)
  - `step/` — step source abstraction, Health Connect integration
  - `ui/` — fragments, adapters, editor, reader
  - `utils/` — persistence (`ProgressManager`, `StepHistoryManager`,
    `Logger`), helpers
- `app/src/main/res/` — layouts, drawables, strings, themes
- `app/src/main/res/raw/test_adventure.json` — sample adventure used for testing
- `docs/` — documentation

## Architecture invariants

The step pipeline has three layers, from lowest to highest:

1. **Source** — `StepCounterService` (sensor) or optional
   `HealthConnectStepSource`. Emits step *deltas*; never touches game state
   or `progress.json`.
2. **History** — `StepHistoryManager`, the single owner of step history
   (30 daily buckets + monotonic `totalStepsAllTime`; in-memory cache,
   batched disk writes, `Mutex`-protected).
3. **Game** — `AdventureReaderFragment` reads only aggregates from
   `StepHistoryManager` and owns chapter-gate state (`remainingSteps`,
   `isGateActive`).

Future features (achievements, step-gated choices, adventure unlocks, ranks)
build on `StepHistoryManager`'s read APIs and must not open `progress.json`
or `step_history.json` directly. Full details will be documented in
[docs/architecture.md](./docs/architecture.md).

## Contributing

Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md) before opening a Pull Request.

Project conventions:

- **Source-code comments are in English.** All Russian comments in the code
  must be translated to English.
- `test_adventure.json` is the reference sample adventure. It must be
  updated whenever the app gains new features, so it always exercises the
  current feature set.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](./LICENSE).

#!/bin/sh

#
# Copyright © 2015 the original authors.
#
# Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
# you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
# You may obtain a copy of the License at
#
#      https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
#
# Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
# WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
# limitations under the License.
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#

##############################################################################
#
#   Gradle start up script for POSIX generated by Gradle.
#
#   Important for running:
#
#   (1) You need a POSIX-compliant shell to run this script. If your /bin/sh is
#       noncompliant, but you have some other compliant shell such as ksh or
#       bash, then to run this script, type that shell name before the whole
#       command line, like:
#
#           ksh Gradle
#
#       Busybox and similar reduced shells will NOT work, because this script
#       requires all of these POSIX shell features:
#         * functions;
#         * expansions «$var», «${var}», «${var:-default}», «${var+SET}»,
#           «${var#prefix}», «${var%suffix}», and «$( cmd )»;
#         * compound commands having a testable exit status, especially «case»;
#         * various built-in commands including «command», «set», and «ulimit».
#
#   Important for patching:
#
#   (2) This script targets any POSIX shell, so it avoids extensions provided
#       by Bash, Ksh, etc; in particular arrays are avoided.
#
#       The "traditional" practice of packing multiple parameters into a
#       space-separated string is a well documented source of bugs and security
#       problems, so this is (mostly) avoided, by progressively accumulating
#       options in "$@", and eventually passing that to Java.
#
#       Where the inherited environment variables (DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS,
#       and GRADLE_OPTS) rely on word-splitting, this is performed explicitly;
#       see the in-line comments for details.
#
#       There are tweaks for specific operating systems such as AIX, CygWin,
#       Darwin, MinGW, and NonStop.
#
#   (3) This script is generated from the Groovy template
#       https://github.com/gradle/gradle/blob/HEAD/platforms/jvm/plugins-application/src/main/resources/org/gradle/api/internal/plugins/unixStartScript.txt
#       within the Gradle project.
#
#       You can find Gradle at https://github.com/gradle/gradle/.
#
##############################################################################

# Attempt to set APP_HOME

# Resolve links: $0 may be a link
app_path=$0

# Need this for daisy-chained symlinks.
while
    APP_HOME=${app_path%"${app_path##*/}"}  # leaves a trailing /; empty if no leading path
    [ -h "$app_path" ]
do
    ls=$( ls -ld "$app_path" )
    link=${ls#*' -> '}
    case $link in             #(
      /*)   app_path=$link ;; #(
      *)    app_path=$APP_HOME$link ;;
    esac
done

# This is normally unused
# shellcheck disable=SC2034
APP_BASE_NAME=${0##*/}
# Discard cd standard output in case $CDPATH is set (https://github.com/gradle/gradle/issues/25036)
APP_HOME=$( cd -P "${APP_HOME:-./}" > /dev/null && printf '%s\n' "$PWD" ) || exit

# Use the maximum available, or set MAX_FD != -1 to use that value.
MAX_FD=maximum

warn () {
    echo "$*"
} >&2

die () {
    echo
    echo "$*"
    echo
    exit 1
} >&2

# OS specific support (must be 'true' or 'false').
cygwin=false
msys=false
darwin=false
nonstop=false
case "$( uname )" in                #(
  CYGWIN* )         cygwin=true  ;; #(
  Darwin* )         darwin=true  ;; #(
  MSYS* | MINGW* )  msys=true    ;; #(
  NONSTOP* )        nonstop=true ;;
esac

CLASSPATH="\\\"\\\""


# Determine the Java command to use to start the JVM.
if [ -n "$JAVA_HOME" ] ; then
    if [ -x "$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java" ] ; then
        # IBM's JDK on AIX uses strange locations for the executables
        JAVACMD=$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java
    else
        JAVACMD=$JAVA_HOME/bin/java
    fi
    if [ ! -x "$JAVACMD" ] ; then
        die "ERROR: JAVA_HOME is set to an invalid directory: $JAVA_HOME

Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
location of your Java installation."
    fi
else
    JAVACMD=java
    if ! command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1
    then
        die "ERROR: JAVA_HOME is not set and no 'java' command could be found in your PATH.

Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
location of your Java installation."
    fi
fi

# Increase the maximum file descriptors if we can.
if ! "$cygwin" && ! "$darwin" && ! "$nonstop" ; then
    case $MAX_FD in #(
      max*)
        # In POSIX sh, ulimit -H is undefined. That's why the result is checked to see if it worked.
        # shellcheck disable=SC2039,SC3045
        MAX_FD=$( ulimit -H -n ) ||
            warn "Could not query maximum file descriptor limit"
    esac
    case $MAX_FD in  #(
      '' | soft) :;; #(
      *)
        # In POSIX sh, ulimit -n is undefined. That's why the result is checked to see if it worked.
        # shellcheck disable=SC2039,SC3045
        ulimit -n "$MAX_FD" ||
            warn "Could not set maximum file descriptor limit to $MAX_FD"
    esac
fi

# Collect all arguments for the java command, stacking in reverse order:
#   * args from the command line
#   * the main class name
#   * -classpath
#   * -D...appname settings
#   * --module-path (only if needed)
#   * DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS, and GRADLE_OPTS environment variables.

# For Cygwin or MSYS, switch paths to Windows format before running java
if "$cygwin" || "$msys" ; then
    APP_HOME=$( cygpath --path --mixed "$APP_HOME" )
    CLASSPATH=$( cygpath --path --mixed "$CLASSPATH" )

    JAVACMD=$( cygpath --unix "$JAVACMD" )

    # Now convert the arguments - kludge to limit ourselves to /bin/sh
    for arg do
        if
            case $arg in                                #(
              -*)   false ;;                            # don't mess with options #(
              /?*)  t=${arg#/} t=/${t%%/*}              # looks like a POSIX filepath
                    [ -e "$t" ] ;;                      #(
              *)    false ;;
            esac
        then
            arg=$( cygpath --path --ignore --mixed "$arg" )
        fi
        # Roll the args list around exactly as many times as the number of
        # args, so each arg winds up back in the position where it started, but
        # possibly modified.
        #
        # NB: a `for` loop captures its iteration list before it begins, so
        # changing the positional parameters here affects neither the number of
        # iterations, nor the values presented in `arg`.
        shift                   # remove old arg
        set -- "$@" "$arg"      # push replacement arg
    done
fi


# Add default JVM options here. You can also use JAVA_OPTS and GRADLE_OPTS to pass JVM options to this script.
DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS='"-Xmx64m" "-Xms64m"'

# Collect all arguments for the java command:
#   * DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS, and optsEnvironmentVar are not allowed to contain shell fragments,
#     and any embedded shellness will be escaped.
#   * For example: A user cannot expect ${Hostname} to be expanded, as it is an environment variable and will be
#     treated as '${Hostname}' itself on the command line.

set -- \
        "-Dorg.gradle.appname=$APP_BASE_NAME" \
        -classpath "$CLASSPATH" \
        -jar "$APP_HOME/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar" \
        "$@"

# Stop when "xargs" is not available.
if ! command -v xargs >/dev/null 2>&1
then
    die "xargs is not available"
fi

# Use "xargs" to parse quoted args.
#
# With -n1 it outputs one arg per line, with the quotes and backslashes removed.
#
# In Bash we could simply go:
#
#   readarray ARGS < <( xargs -n1 <<<"$var" ) &&
#   set -- "${ARGS[@]}" "$@"
#
# but POSIX shell has neither arrays nor command substitution, so instead we
# post-process each arg (as a line of input to sed) to backslash-escape any
# character that might be a shell metacharacter, then use eval to reverse
# that process (while maintaining the separation between arguments), and wrap
# the whole thing up as a single "set" statement.
#
# This will of course break if any of these variables contains a newline or
# an unmatched quote.
#

eval "set -- $(
        printf '%s\n' "$DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS $JAVA_OPTS $GRADLE_OPTS" |
        xargs -n1 |
        sed ' s~[^-[:alnum:]+,./:=@_]~\\&~g; ' |
        tr '\n' ' '
    )" '"$@"'

exec "$JAVACMD" "$@"

@if "%DEBUG%"=="" @echo off
@rem ##########################################################################
@rem
@rem  Gradle startup script for Windows
@rem
@rem ##########################################################################

@rem Set local scope for the variables with windows NT shell
if "%OS%"=="Windows_NT" setlocal

set DIRNAME=%~dp0
if "%DIRNAME%"=="" set DIRNAME=.
@rem This is normally unused
set APP_BASE_NAME=%~n0
set APP_HOME=%DIRNAME%

@rem Resolve any "." and ".." in APP_HOME to make it shorter.
for %%i in ("%APP_HOME%") do set APP_HOME=%%~fi

@rem Add default JVM options here. You can also use JAVA_OPTS and GRADLE_OPTS to pass JVM options to this script.
set DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS="-Xmx64m" "-Xms64m"

@rem Find java.exe
if defined JAVA_HOME goto findJavaFromJavaHome

set JAVA_EXE=java.exe
%JAVA_EXE% -version >NUL 2>&1
if %ERRORLEVEL% equ 0 goto execute

echo. 1>&2
echo ERROR: JAVA_HOME is not set and no 'java' command could be found in your PATH. 1>&2
echo. 1>&2
echo Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the 1>&2
echo location of your Java installation. 1>&2

goto fail

:findJavaFromJavaHome
set JAVA_HOME=%JAVA_HOME:"=%
set JAVA_EXE=%JAVA_HOME%/bin/java.exe

if exist "%JAVA_EXE%" goto execute

echo. 1>&2
echo ERROR: JAVA_HOME is set to an invalid directory: %JAVA_HOME% 1>&2
echo. 1>&2
echo Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the 1>&2
echo location of your Java installation. 1>&2

goto fail

:execute
@rem Setup the command line

set CLASSPATH=


@rem Execute Gradle
"%JAVA_EXE%" %DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS% %JAVA_OPTS% %GRADLE_OPTS% "-Dorg.gradle.appname=%APP_BASE_NAME%" -classpath "%CLASSPATH%" -jar "%APP_HOME%\gradle\wrapper\gradle-wrapper.jar" %*

:end
@rem End local scope for the variables with windows NT shell
if %ERRORLEVEL% equ 0 goto mainEnd

:fail
rem Set variable GRADLE_EXIT_CONSOLE if you need the _script_ return code instead of
rem the _cmd.exe /c_ return code!
set EXIT_CODE=%ERRORLEVEL%
if %EXIT_CODE% equ 0 set EXIT_CODE=1
if not ""=="%GRADLE_EXIT_CONSOLE%" exit %EXIT_CODE%
exit /b %EXIT_CODE%

:mainEnd
if "%OS%"=="Windows_NT" endlocal

:omega

function navigate(an_id) {
  problem_div = document.getElementById("d" + an_id);
  preview_div = document.getElementById("preview");
  preview_div.innerHTML = problem_div != null ? problem_div.innerHTML : "Select a problem element in tree";
}

package com.myapp.adventure

import android.os.Bundle
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import com.myapp.adventure.ui.setup.SetupFragment
import com.myapp.adventure.utils.Logger

class MainActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_main)

        val prefs = getSharedPreferences("adventure_prefs", MODE_PRIVATE)
        val savedUri = prefs.getString("adventure_folder_uri", null)
        if (savedUri != null) {
            Logger.init(this, savedUri)
        }

        com.myapp.adventure.step.StepSourceManager.start(this)

        if (savedInstanceState == null) {
            supportFragmentManager.beginTransaction()
                .replace(R.id.fragment_container, SetupFragment())
                .commit()
        }
    }
}

package com.myapp.adventure.data

import com.google.gson.annotations.SerializedName

data class Adventure(
    val title: String,
    val author: String = "Неизвестен",
    val description: String = "",
    @SerializedName("initial_state")
    val initialState: PlayerState? = null,
    val tags: List<TagDefinition>? = null,
    @SerializedName("death_scene")
    val deathScene: DeathScene? = null,
    val chapters: List<Chapter>? = null
)

data class DeathScene(
    val id: String = "death_scene",
    val text: String = "💀 Вы погибли.",
    @SerializedName("allow_step_back")
    val allowStepBack: Boolean = true,
    @SerializedName("allow_chapter_restart")
    val allowChapterRestart: Boolean = true,
    @SerializedName("allow_adventure_restart")
    val allowAdventureRestart: Boolean = true
)

data class Chapter(
    val id: String,
    val title: String = "",
    @SerializedName("required_steps")
    val requiredSteps: Int = 0,
    val scenes: List<Scene>? = null
)

data class Scene(
    val id: String,
    val text: String,
    @SerializedName("set_flags")
    val setFlags: List<String>? = null,
    @SerializedName("remove_flags")
    val removeFlags: List<String>? = null,
    @SerializedName("modify_stats")
    val modifyStats: Map<String, Int>? = null,
    val choices: List<Choice>? = null
)

data class Choice(
    val text: String,
    @SerializedName("next_scene")
    val nextScene: String,
    val condition: String? = null,
    @SerializedName("set_flags")
    val setFlags: List<String>? = null,
    @SerializedName("remove_flags")
    val removeFlags: List<String>? = null,
    @SerializedName("modify_stats")
    val modifyStats: Map<String, Int>? = null
)

data class PlayerState(
    val flags: List<String>? = null,
    val stats: Map<String, Int>? = null
)

package com.myapp.adventure.data

import java.util.UUID

data class EditorScene(
    val uid: String = UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
    var id: String = "",
    var idIsAuto: Boolean = true,
    var title: String = "",
    var text: String = "",
    var isChapterEnd: Boolean = false,
    var requiredSteps: Int = 0,
    var isDeathScene: Boolean = false,
    var deathAllowStepBack: Boolean = true,
    var deathAllowChapterRestart: Boolean = true,
    var deathAllowAdventureRestart: Boolean = true,
    val tags: MutableList<EditorTag> = mutableListOf(),
    val choices: MutableList<EditorChoice> = mutableListOf()
)

data class EditorChoice(
    val uid: String = UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
    var text: String = "",
    var nextSceneId: String = "",
    var conditionTag: String = "",
    val tags: MutableList<EditorTag> = mutableListOf()
)

data class EditorTag(
    var name: String = "",
    var value: Int = 0,
    var isStatModifier: Boolean = false,
    var category: TagCategory = TagCategory.JOURNAL,
    var displayName: String = "",
    var visible: Boolean = false
)

fun EditorScene.deepCopy(): EditorScene = copy(
    tags = tags.map { it.copy() }.toMutableList(),
    choices = choices.map { choice ->
        choice.copy(tags = choice.tags.map { it.copy() }.toMutableList())
    }.toMutableList()
)

data class RebuildResult(
    val oldId: String,
    val newId: String,
    val updatedReferences: Int
)

package com.myapp.adventure.data

data class ProgressData(
    val adventureFileName: String,
    val currentChapterIndex: Int = 0,
    val currentSceneId: String = "",
    val flags: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val stats: Map<String, Int> = emptyMap(),
    val appliedSceneEffects: Set<String> = emptySet(),
    val itemOrder: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val previousStepSnapshot: PlayerStateSnapshot? = null,
    val chapterStartSnapshot: PlayerStateSnapshot? = null,

    // ----- Steps gate (delta-based, survives reboot) -----

    /** Steps remaining until the next chapter opens. */
    val remainingSteps: Int = 0,

    /** Whether a steps gate is currently active. */
    val isGateActive: Boolean = false,

    /**
     * Raw TYPE_STEP_COUNTER reading at the moment this ProgressData was saved.
     * On load, the delta (currentAbsolute - lastAbsoluteAtSave) is subtracted from
     * [remainingSteps] to catch up with steps taken while the app was closed.
     * -1 means "unknown" (sensor has not produced any event yet).
     */
    val lastAbsoluteAtSave: Int = -1
)

FILE: app/src/main/java/com/myapp/adventure/data/StepHistoryData.kt

package com.myapp.adventure.data

/**
 * One day's worth of steps.
 *
 * @param date  local date in ISO format ("2026-11-04")
 * @param steps delta for this day (not an absolute sensor reading)
 */
data class StepBucket(
    val date: String,
    val steps: Int
)

/**
 * Persisted step history.
 *
 * [buckets] are sorted by [StepBucket.date] ascending and capped at 30 entries
 * (older entries are dropped). [totalStepsAllTime] is a monotonic counter that
 * is never trimmed and is independent of [buckets].
 */
data class StepHistoryData(
    val totalStepsAllTime: Long = 0L,
    val buckets: List<StepBucket> = emptyList()
)

package com.myapp.adventure.service

object StepCounterConstants {
    const val ACTION_START = "com.myapp.adventure.START_STEP_COUNTER"
    const val ACTION_STOP = "com.myapp.adventure.STOP_STEP_COUNTER"
    const val ACTION_UPDATE = "com.myapp.adventure.UPDATE_STEPS"

    /** Absolute (raw) reading from the step counter sensor since boot. */
    const val EXTRA_ABSOLUTE_STEPS = "absolute_steps"

    /** Delta since the previous sensor event (diff of absolute readings). */
    const val EXTRA_DELTA = "delta_steps"

    /**
     * Boolean: whether a step counter sensor is present on this device.
     * Broadcast together with [ACTION_UPDATE] so consumers can react to it.
     */
    const val EXTRA_SENSOR_AVAILABLE = "sensor_available"

    const val NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_ID = "step_counter_channel"
    const val NOTIFICATION_ID = 1
}

package com.myapp.adventure.service

import android.app.Notification
import android.app.NotificationChannel
import android.app.NotificationManager
import android.app.PendingIntent
import android.app.Service
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.hardware.Sensor
import android.hardware.SensorEvent
import android.hardware.SensorEventListener
import android.hardware.SensorManager
import android.os.IBinder
import androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat
import com.myapp.adventure.MainActivity
import com.myapp.adventure.utils.Logger
import com.myapp.adventure.utils.StepHistoryManager
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.SupervisorJob
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.isActive
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger

class StepCounterService : Service(), SensorEventListener {

    companion object {
        /** Hint for UI only. Never gate startForeground() on this. */
        var isRunning = false

        /** Last raw absolute reading from the sensor. */
        @Volatile
        var absoluteSteps: Int = 0
            private set

        /** True once at least one sensor event has been received in this process. */
        @Volatile
        var hasFirstEvent: Boolean = false
            private set

        /** True if this device has a TYPE_STEP_COUNTER sensor. */
        @Volatile
        var isSensorAvailable: Boolean = false
            private set

        private const val PREFS_NAME = "step_counter_service_prefs"
        private const val KEY_LAST_RAW = "last_raw_value"
    }

    private lateinit var sensorManager: SensorManager
    private var stepSensor: Sensor? = null
    private var isListening = false

    // ----- Baseline / delta tracking (accessed from onSensorChanged) -----

    /**
     * Last raw value we've seen. Loaded from prefs on start so a process restart
     * (without reboot) doesn't lose the baseline.
     * -1 means "unknown".
     */
    @Volatile
    private var lastRawSteps: Int = -1

    /** True once we have a valid baseline. */
    @Volatile
    private var hasBaseline: Boolean = false

    /** Accumulated delta waiting to be flushed by the background worker. */
    private val pendingDelta = AtomicInteger(0)

    /** Set by onSensorChanged when a sensor reboot is detected; consumed in the worker. */
    private val rebootDetected = AtomicBoolean(false)

    // ----- Background worker -----

    private val scope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.IO)
    private var workerJob: Job? = null

    // ==================== Lifecycle ====================

    override fun onCreate() {
        super.onCreate()

        val prefs = getSharedPreferences("adventure_prefs", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        val folderUriString = prefs.getString("adventure_folder_uri", null)
        if (folderUriString != null) {
            Logger.init(applicationContext, folderUriString)
        }

        createNotificationChannel()

        sensorManager = getSystemService(Context.SENSOR_SERVICE) as SensorManager
        stepSensor = sensorManager.getDefaultSensor(Sensor.TYPE_STEP_COUNTER)
        isSensorAvailable = stepSensor != null

        val savedRaw = loadLastRaw()
        if (savedRaw >= 0) {
            lastRawSteps = savedRaw
            hasBaseline = true
        }

        Logger.log(
            applicationContext,
            "StepCounterService created, sensor: ${if (isSensorAvailable) "available" else "MISSING"}, " +
                    "savedRaw=$savedRaw"
        )
    }

    override fun onStartCommand(intent: Intent?, flags: Int, startId: Int): Int {
        Logger.log(
            applicationContext,
            "onStartCommand: action=${intent?.action}, isRunning=$isRunning, isListening=$isListening"
        )

        when (intent?.action) {
            StepCounterConstants.ACTION_STOP -> {
                Logger.log(applicationContext, "ACTION_STOP received, stopping service")
                shutdown()
                return START_NOT_STICKY
            }
            else -> {
                // ACTION_START, null (START_STICKY restart), or unknown action.
                // startForeground is idempotent; Android 12+ requires it within 5s.
                startForeground(StepCounterConstants.NOTIFICATION_ID, buildNotificationStatic())
                isRunning = true

                if (!isListening && stepSensor != null) {
                    sensorManager.registerListener(
                        this,
                        stepSensor,
                        SensorManager.SENSOR_DELAY_NORMAL
                    )
                    isListening = true
                    Logger.log(applicationContext, "Sensor listener registered")
                }

                startWorker()
            }
        }
        return START_STICKY
    }

    override fun onBind(intent: Intent?): IBinder? = null

    override fun onDestroy() {
        stopWorker()
        stopListening()
        isRunning = false
        Logger.log(applicationContext, "StepCounterService destroyed")
        super.onDestroy()
    }

    // ==================== Sensor ====================

    override fun onSensorChanged(event: SensorEvent?) {
        if (event?.sensor?.type != Sensor.TYPE_STEP_COUNTER) return

        val raw = event.values[0].toInt()
        absoluteSteps = raw
        hasFirstEvent = true

        // Sensor reboot detection: a fresh boot resets the counter to a small value.
        if (hasBaseline && raw < lastRawSteps) {
            lastRawSteps = raw
            saveLastRaw(raw)
            pendingDelta.set(0)
            rebootDetected.set(true)
            broadcastUpdate(raw, 0)
            return
        }

        val delta = if (hasBaseline) (raw - lastRawSteps).coerceAtLeast(0) else 0
        if (!hasBaseline) {
            hasBaseline = true
        }
        lastRawSteps = raw
        saveLastRaw(raw)

        if (delta > 0) {
            pendingDelta.addAndGet(delta)
        }

        broadcastUpdate(raw, delta)
    }

    override fun onAccuracyChanged(sensor: Sensor?, accuracy: Int) {}

    private fun broadcastUpdate(raw: Int, delta: Int) {
        sendBroadcast(
            Intent(StepCounterConstants.ACTION_UPDATE).apply {
                setPackage(packageName)
                putExtra(StepCounterConstants.EXTRA_ABSOLUTE_STEPS, raw)
                putExtra(StepCounterConstants.EXTRA_DELTA, delta)
                putExtra(StepCounterConstants.EXTRA_SENSOR_AVAILABLE, isSensorAvailable)
            }
        )
    }

    private fun stopListening() {
        if (isListening) {
            sensorManager.unregisterListener(this)
            isListening = false
        }
    }

    // ==================== Background worker ====================

    /**
     * Runs while the service is in foreground.
     * Every 1.5s drains pendingDelta into StepHistoryManager, every ~15s refreshes the notification.
     * Does NOT touch the sensor.
     */
    private fun startWorker() {
        stopWorker()
        workerJob = scope.launch {
            var ticksSinceNotifUpdate = 0
            while (isActive) {
                delay(1_500L)

                val delta = pendingDelta.getAndSet(0)
                if (delta > 0) {
                    try {
                        StepHistoryManager.recordDelta(applicationContext, delta)
                    } catch (e: Exception) {
                        Logger.log(applicationContext, "recordDelta failed: ${e.message}")
                    }
                }

                if (rebootDetected.compareAndSet(true, false)) {
                    Logger.log(
                        applicationContext,
                        "Sensor reboot detected, baseline reset to $lastRawSteps"
                    )
                }

                ticksSinceNotifUpdate++
                if (ticksSinceNotifUpdate >= 10) {
                    ticksSinceNotifUpdate = 0
                    refreshNotificationContent()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun stopWorker() {
        workerJob?.cancel()
        workerJob = null
    }

    private fun shutdown() {
        stopWorker()
        stopListening()
        // Try to flush the last pending delta before stopping.
        val tail = pendingDelta.getAndSet(0)
        if (tail > 0) {
            scope.launch {
                try {
                    StepHistoryManager.recordDelta(applicationContext, tail)
                } catch (_: Exception) {
                }
            }
        }
        isRunning = false
        stopForeground(STOP_FOREGROUND_REMOVE)
        stopSelf()
    }

    // ==================== Notification ====================

    /** Static notification used to satisfy startForeground() within 5s. */
    private fun buildNotificationStatic(): Notification {
        val text = if (!isSensorAvailable) {
            "Датчик шагов недоступен на этом устройстве"
        } else if (!hasFirstEvent) {
            "Ожидание данных датчика…"
        } else {
            "Отслеживание шагов активно"
        }
        return newNotificationBuilder()
            .setContentText(text)
            .build()
    }

    private fun refreshNotificationContent() {
        if (!isRunning) return

        val todaySteps = try {
            StepHistoryManager.getTodaySteps(applicationContext)
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            0
        }

        val text = when {
            !isSensorAvailable -> "Датчик шагов недоступен на этом устройстве"
            !hasFirstEvent -> "Ожидание данных датчика…"
            else -> "Сегодня: $todaySteps шагов"
        }

        val notification = newNotificationBuilder()
            .setContentText(text)
            .build()

        val manager = getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as NotificationManager
        manager.notify(StepCounterConstants.NOTIFICATION_ID, notification)
    }

    private fun newNotificationBuilder(): NotificationCompat.Builder {
        val pendingIntent = PendingIntent.getActivity(
            this,
            0,
            Intent(this, MainActivity::class.java),
            PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE
        )
        return NotificationCompat.Builder(this, StepCounterConstants.NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_ID)
            .setContentTitle("Шагомер Adventure")
            .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.ic_dialog_info)
            .setContentIntent(pendingIntent)
            .setOngoing(true)
            .setOnlyAlertOnce(true)
    }

    private fun createNotificationChannel() {
        val channel = NotificationChannel(
            StepCounterConstants.NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_ID,
            "Шагомер",
            NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW
        )
        val manager = getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as NotificationManager
        manager.createNotificationChannel(channel)
    }

    // ==================== Baseline persistence ====================

    private fun saveLastRaw(value: Int) {
        try {
            getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                .edit()
                .putInt(KEY_LAST_RAW, value)
                .apply()
        } catch (_: Exception) {
        }
    }

    private fun loadLastRaw(): Int {
        return try {
            getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                .getInt(KEY_LAST_RAW, -1)
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            -1
        }
    }
}

FILE: app/src/main/java/com/myapp/adventure/step/HealthConnectStepSource.kt

package com.myapp.adventure.step

import android.content.Context
import androidx.health.connect.client.HealthConnectClient
import androidx.health.connect.client.permission.HealthPermission
import androidx.health.connect.client.records.StepsRecord
import androidx.health.connect.client.request.AggregateRequest
import androidx.health.connect.client.time.TimeRangeFilter
import com.myapp.adventure.utils.Logger
import java.time.Instant
import java.time.LocalDate
import java.time.ZoneId

/**
 * Health Connect step source.
 *
 * Reads aggregate step count for "today" from Health Connect. The first call
 * establishes a baseline (today's total at that moment). Each subsequent call
 * returns the difference between today's total and the baseline.
 *
 * Data may arrive with a delay: Health Connect aggregates records written by
 * other apps, and Google recommends not writing more than once every 15 min.
 * So the game gate may update with a lag — we document this in UI.
 */
class HealthConnectStepSource : StepSource {

    companion object {
        private const val TAG = "HealthConnectStepSource"
        const val PROVIDER_PACKAGE = "com.google.android.apps.healthdata"
    }

    override val id: String = "health_connect"

    // Baseline: today's aggregate at the moment we started using HC for this day.
    @Volatile private var baselineDate: String? = null
    @Volatile private var baselineTotal: Long = 0L
    @Volatile private var lastSeenTotal: Long = 0L

    override fun isAvailable(context: Context): Boolean {
        val status = HealthConnectClient.getSdkStatus(context, PROVIDER_PACKAGE)
        if (status != HealthConnectClient.SDK_AVAILABLE) return false
        return true
    }

    suspend fun hasReadPermission(context: Context): Boolean {
        return try {
            val client = HealthConnectClient.getOrCreate(context)
            val granted = client.permissionController.getGrantedPermissions()
            granted.contains(HealthPermission.getReadPermission(StepsRecord::class))
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.log(context, "$TAG: permission check failed: ${e.message}")
            false
        }
    }

    override suspend fun getDelta(context: Context): Int {
        if (!hasReadPermission(context)) return 0

        val today = LocalDate.now()
        val todayKey = today.toString()

        return try {
            val client = HealthConnectClient.getOrCreate(context)
            val zone = ZoneId.systemDefault()
            val start = today.atStartOfDay(zone).toInstant()
            val end = Instant.now()

            val response = client.aggregate(
                AggregateRequest(
                    metrics = setOf(StepsRecord.COUNT_TOTAL),
                    timeRangeFilter = TimeRangeFilter.between(start, end)
                )
            )
            val total = response[StepsRecord.COUNT_TOTAL] ?: 0L

            if (baselineDate != todayKey) {
                // First read today (or first read after day rollover).
                baselineDate = todayKey
                baselineTotal = total
                lastSeenTotal = total
                Logger.log(context, "$TAG: baseline for $todayKey = $total")
                return 0
            }

            val delta = (total - lastSeenTotal).coerceAtLeast(0L)
            lastSeenTotal = total
            if (delta > 0) Logger.log(context, "$TAG: delta=$delta (total=$total)")
            delta.toInt()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.log(context, "$TAG: aggregate failed: ${e.message}")
            0
        }
    }

    /** Called by StepSourceManager on day rollover to reset baseline. */
    fun onDayChanged() {
        baselineDate = null
        baselineTotal = 0L
        lastSeenTotal = 0L
    }
}

package com.myapp.adventure.step

import android.content.Context
import com.myapp.adventure.service.StepCounterService

/**
 * Wraps [StepCounterService] as a [StepSource].
 *
 * The service already accumulates a delta in [StepCounterService] and writes
 * to [StepHistoryManager]. To avoid double-counting, this source does NOT
 * call recordDelta itself — it only reports what the service has accumulated
 * since the last poll via [consumePendingDelta].
 *
 * Note: StepCounterService writes to StepHistoryManager independently, so this
 * source's delta is informational for the manager (used to compare with HC).
 * The manager applies max-per-bucket semantics when both sources report.
 */
class SensorStepSource : StepSource {

    override val id: String = "sensor"

    override fun isAvailable(context: Context): Boolean {
        return StepCounterService.isSensorAvailable
    }

    override suspend fun getDelta(context: Context): Int {
        // Sensor source does not push deltas through StepSourceManager;
        // StepCounterService already writes them directly.
        // Returning 0 keeps StepSourceManager idempotent.
        return 0
    }
}

FILE: app/src/main/java/com/myapp/adventure/step/StepSource.kt

package com.myapp.adventure.step

import android.content.Context

/**
 * Abstraction over a step data source.
 *
 * Implementations must be cheap to construct. Heavy initialization belongs
 * in [StepSourceManager].
 */
interface StepSource {

    /** Stable identifier used for logging and prefs. */
    val id: String

    /**
     * Whether this source can currently be used.
     * For Health Connect this checks [HealthConnectClient.getSdkStatus] and
     * whether the READ_STEPS permission has been granted.
     */
    fun isAvailable(context: Context): Boolean

    /**
     * Delta (steps) since the previous call. Return 0 if nothing new.
     *
     * Implementations must handle their own baseline internally. For the sensor
     * source, delta is derived from [StepCounterService] events. For Health
     * Connect, delta is derived from aggregate calls over a sliding window.
     */
    suspend fun getDelta(context: Context): Int
}

FILE: app/src/main/java/com/myapp/adventure/step/StepSourceManager.kt
================================================
package com.myapp.adventure.step

import android.content.Context
import com.myapp.adventure.utils.Logger
import com.myapp.adventure.utils.StepHistoryManager
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.SupervisorJob
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.isActive
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

/**
 * Chooses the active step source and polls it periodically.
 *
 * - If user preference is "health_connect" AND HC is available AND permission granted
 *   → polls HealthConnectStepSource.
 * - Otherwise → SensorStepSource (passive; StepCounterService already writes deltas).
 *
 * Polling interval is 60 seconds. Health Connect may lag, so the gate in
 * AdventureReaderFragment updates with a delay when HC is active. This is documented in UI.
 */
object StepSourceManager {

    private const val TAG = "StepSourceManager"
    private const val PREFS_NAME = "step_source_prefs"
    private const val KEY_USE_HEALTH_CONNECT = "use_health_connect"
    private const val POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 60_000L

    private val scope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.IO)
    private var pollJob: Job? = null

    private val sensorSource = SensorStepSource()
    private val healthConnectSource = HealthConnectStepSource()

    // ----- User preference -----

    fun isHealthConnectEnabled(context: Context): Boolean {
        return context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .getBoolean(KEY_USE_HEALTH_CONNECT, false)
    }

    fun setHealthConnectEnabled(context: Context, enabled: Boolean) {
        context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .edit().putBoolean(KEY_USE_HEALTH_CONNECT, enabled).apply()
        Logger.log(context, "$TAG: Health Connect enabled=$enabled")
        restartPolling(context.applicationContext)
    }

    /**
     * True if the user enabled HC AND HC is currently usable (installed + permission granted).
     * UI uses this to decide whether to show "updating every N minutes" hint.
     */
    fun isHealthConnectActive(context: Context): Boolean {
        if (!isHealthConnectEnabled(context)) return false
        if (!healthConnectSource.isAvailable(context)) return false
        // Permission check is suspend; we use a lightweight synchronous heuristic here.
        // The actual check happens on each poll; if permission is missing, getDelta returns 0
        // and the source falls back to sensor on the next poll.
        return true
    }

    // ----- Lifecycle -----

    /** Call from SetupFragment / MainActivity once per process. */
    fun start(context: Context) {
        restartPolling(context.applicationContext)
    }

    fun stop() {
        pollJob?.cancel()
        pollJob = null
    }

    private fun restartPolling(appContext: Context) {
        stop()
        pollJob = scope.launch {
            while (isActive) {
                try {
                    pollOnce(appContext)
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    Logger.log(appContext, "$TAG: poll failed: ${e.message}")
                }
                delay(POLL_INTERVAL_MS)
            }
        }
    }

    private suspend fun pollOnce(appContext: Context) {
        val useHc = isHealthConnectEnabled(appContext) &&
                healthConnectSource.isAvailable(appContext) &&
                healthConnectSource.hasReadPermission(appContext)

        if (!useHc) {
            // Sensor source writes deltas directly via StepCounterService.
            // Nothing to push here.
            return
        }

        val delta = healthConnectSource.getDelta(appContext)
        if (delta > 0) {
            // Use applyBucketMax through a public wrapper (see StepHistoryManager patch below).
            StepHistoryManager.applyHealthConnectDelta(appContext, delta)
            Logger.log(appContext, "$TAG: HC delta=$delta applied")
        }
    }
}

package com.myapp.adventure.ui

import android.app.AlertDialog
import android.content.ClipData
import android.content.ClipboardManager
import android.content.Context
import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment
import androidx.lifecycle.lifecycleScope
import com.myapp.adventure.databinding.FragmentLogViewerBinding
import com.myapp.adventure.utils.FontManager
import com.myapp.adventure.utils.Logger
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

class LogViewerFragment : Fragment() {

    private var _binding: FragmentLogViewerBinding? = null
    private val binding get() = _binding!!

    /** Cached log text so "Copy" works without an extra disk read. */
    private var currentLogText: String = ""

    override fun onCreateView(
        inflater: LayoutInflater,
        container: ViewGroup?,
        savedInstanceState: Bundle?
    ): View {
        _binding = FragmentLogViewerBinding.inflate(inflater, container, false)
        return binding.root
    }

    override fun onViewCreated(view: View, savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState)

        val fontName = FontManager.getSelectedFont(requireContext())
        FontManager.applyFontToViewTree(view, fontName, requireContext())

        binding.btnCopyLog.setOnClickListener { copyLogToClipboard() }
        binding.btnClearLog.setOnClickListener { confirmClearLog() }

        loadLog()
    }

    private fun loadLog() {
        if (_binding == null) return
        binding.tvLogContent.text = "Загрузка…"

        viewLifecycleOwner.lifecycleScope.launch {
            val appContext = requireContext().applicationContext
            val logText = Logger.getLogContent(appContext)
            if (_binding == null) return@launch
            currentLogText = logText
            binding.tvLogContent.text = logText
        }
    }

    private fun copyLogToClipboard() {
        if (currentLogText.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "Лог пуст", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }
        val clipboard = requireContext()
            .getSystemService(Context.CLIPBOARD_SERVICE) as ClipboardManager
        val clip = ClipData.newPlainText("log", currentLogText)
        clipboard.setPrimaryClip(clip)
        Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "Лог скопирован в буфер обмена", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT)
            .show()
    }

    private fun confirmClearLog() {
        AlertDialog.Builder(requireContext())
            .setTitle("Очистить лог?")
            .setMessage(
                "Содержимое debug_log.txt будет удалено. " +
                        "Незаписанные строки из буфера тоже будут потеряны. " +
                        "Это действие нельзя отменить."
            )
            .setPositiveButton("Очистить") { _, _ -> clearLog() }
            .setNegativeButton("Отмена", null)
            .show()
    }

                        private fun clearLog() {
                    viewLifecycleOwner.lifecycleScope.launch {
                        val appContext = requireContext().applicationContext
                        Logger.clearLog(appContext)
                        val newLogText = Logger.getLogContent(appContext)
                        if (_binding == null) return@launch
                        currentLogText = newLogText
                        binding.tvLogContent.text = newLogText
                        Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "Лог очищен", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    }
                }

                        override fun onDestroyView() {
                    super.onDestroyView()
                    _binding = null
                }
    }

package com.myapp.adventure.ui

import android.app.AlertDialog
import android.net.Uri
import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.AdapterView
import android.widget.ArrayAdapter
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts
import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment
import androidx.lifecycle.lifecycleScope
import androidx.health.connect.client.HealthConnectClient
import androidx.health.connect.client.PermissionController
import androidx.health.connect.client.permission.HealthPermission
import androidx.health.connect.client.records.StepsRecord
import com.myapp.adventure.databinding.FragmentSettingsBinding
import com.myapp.adventure.step.HealthConnectStepSource
import com.myapp.adventure.step.StepSourceManager
import com.myapp.adventure.utils.FontManager
import com.myapp.adventure.utils.Logger
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

class SettingsFragment : Fragment() {

    private var _binding: FragmentSettingsBinding? = null
    private val binding get() = _binding!!

    private val addFontLauncher = registerForActivityResult(
        ActivityResultContracts.OpenDocument()
    ) { uri: Uri? ->
        if (uri != null) {
            val fileName = requireContext().contentResolver.query(uri, null, null, null, null)?.use { cursor ->
                if (cursor.moveToFirst()) {
                    val idx = cursor.getColumnIndex(android.provider.OpenableColumns.DISPLAY_NAME)
                    if (idx >= 0) cursor.getString(idx) else "font.ttf"
                } else "font.ttf"
            } ?: "font.ttf"

            FontManager.addFont(requireContext(), uri, fileName)
            refreshFontList()
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "Шрифт добавлен: $fileName", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }

    // Health Connect permission launcher
    private val hcPermissionLauncher = registerForActivityResult(
        PermissionController.createRequestPermissionResultContract()
    ) { granted: Set<String> ->
        val required = HealthPermission.getReadPermission(StepsRecord::class)
        val ok = granted.contains(required)
        if (ok) {
            StepSourceManager.setHealthConnectEnabled(requireContext(), true)
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "Health Connect включён", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        } else {
            StepSourceManager.setHealthConnectEnabled(requireContext(), false)
            binding.cbHealthConnect.isChecked = false
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "Разрешение не выдано — используется датчик телефона", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
        }
        refreshHealthConnectStatus()
    }

    override fun onCreateView(
        inflater: LayoutInflater,
        container: ViewGroup?,
        savedInstanceState: Bundle?
    ): View {
        _binding = FragmentSettingsBinding.inflate(inflater, container, false)
        return binding.root
    }

    override fun onViewCreated(view: View, savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState)

        val fontName = FontManager.getSelectedFont(requireContext())
        FontManager.applyFontToViewTree(view, fontName, requireContext())

        // Logging checkbox
        val prefs = requireContext().getSharedPreferences("adventure_prefs", 0)
        val loggingEnabled = prefs.getBoolean("logging_enabled", false)
        binding.cbLogging.isChecked = loggingEnabled

        binding.cbLogging.setOnCheckedChangeListener { _, isChecked ->
            Logger.setEnabled(requireContext(), isChecked)
            Toast.makeText(
                requireContext(),
                if (isChecked) "Логирование включено" else "Логирование выключено",
                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
            ).show()
        }

        setupFontSizeSpinner()
        refreshFontList()

        binding.btnAddFont.setOnClickListener {
            addFontLauncher.launch(arrayOf("font/ttf", "font/otf", "application/x-font-ttf", "application/vnd.ms-opentype"))
        }

        // ----- Health Connect -----
        setupHealthConnect()
    }

    private fun setupHealthConnect() {
        val ctx = requireContext()
        val hcAvailable = HealthConnectClient.getSdkStatus(ctx, HealthConnectStepSource.PROVIDER_PACKAGE) ==
                HealthConnectClient.SDK_AVAILABLE

        binding.cbHealthConnect.isEnabled = hcAvailable
        binding.cbHealthConnect.isChecked = StepSourceManager.isHealthConnectEnabled(ctx)

        if (!hcAvailable) {
            binding.tvHealthConnectStatus.text = "Health Connect недоступен на этом устройстве"
            binding.tvHealthConnectStatus.visibility = View.VISIBLE
        } else {
            refreshHealthConnectStatus()
        }

        binding.cbHealthConnect.setOnCheckedChangeListener { _, isChecked ->
            if (isChecked) {
                // Request permission if not granted
                viewLifecycleOwner.lifecycleScope.launch {
                    val client = HealthConnectClient.getOrCreate(ctx)
                    val granted = client.permissionController.getGrantedPermissions()
                    val required = HealthPermission.getReadPermission(StepsRecord::class)
                    if (granted.contains(required)) {
                        StepSourceManager.setHealthConnectEnabled(ctx, true)
                        refreshHealthConnectStatus()
                    } else {
                        hcPermissionLauncher.launch(setOf(required))
                    }
                }
            } else {
                StepSourceManager.setHealthConnectEnabled(ctx, false)
                refreshHealthConnectStatus()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun refreshHealthConnectStatus() {
        if (_binding == null) return
        val ctx = requireContext()
        val available = HealthConnectClient.getSdkStatus(ctx, HealthConnectStepSource.PROVIDER_PACKAGE) ==
                HealthConnectClient.SDK_AVAILABLE
        if (!available) return

        val enabled = StepSourceManager.isHealthConnectEnabled(ctx)
        val active = StepSourceManager.isHealthConnectActive(ctx)

        binding.tvHealthConnectStatus.visibility = View.VISIBLE
        binding.tvHealthConnectStatus.text = when {
            !enabled -> "Выключено — используется датчик телефона (шаги в реальном времени)"
            active -> "Включено — шаги обновляются с задержкой (Health Connect)"
            else -> "Health Connect недоступен — используется датчик телефона"
        }
    }

    override fun onResume() {
        super.onResume()
        // Permission may have been revoked in system settings while the app was backgrounded.
        // The activity is recreated in that case, but refresh anyway for safety.
        refreshHealthConnectStatus()
    }

    private fun setupFontSizeSpinner() {
        val scales = FontManager.FONT_SCALES
        val sizeAdapter = ArrayAdapter(
            requireContext(),
            android.R.layout.simple_spinner_item,
            scales.map { it.first }
        )
        sizeAdapter.setDropDownViewResource(android.R.layout.simple_spinner_dropdown_item)
        binding.spinnerFontSize.adapter = sizeAdapter

        val currentScale = FontManager.getFontScale(requireContext())
        val currentScaleIdx = scales.indexOfFirst { it.second == currentScale }.coerceAtLeast(0)

        binding.spinnerFontSize.onItemSelectedListener = null
        binding.spinnerFontSize.setSelection(currentScaleIdx)

        binding.spinnerFontSize.onItemSelectedListener = object : AdapterView.OnItemSelectedListener {
            override fun onItemSelected(parent: AdapterView<*>?, view: View?, position: Int, id: Long) {
                val newScale = scales[position].second
                if (newScale != FontManager.getFontScale(requireContext())) {
                    FontManager.setFontScale(requireContext(), newScale)
                    requireActivity().recreate()
                }
            }
            override fun onNothingSelected(parent: AdapterView<*>?) {}
        }
    }

    private fun refreshFontList() {
        val fonts = FontManager.getAvailableFonts(requireContext())
        val adapter = ArrayAdapter(requireContext(), android.R.layout.simple_spinner_item, fonts)
        adapter.setDropDownViewResource(android.R.layout.simple_spinner_dropdown_item)
        binding.spinnerFont.adapter = adapter

        val selectedFont = FontManager.getSelectedFont(requireContext())
        val position = fonts.indexOf(selectedFont)
        if (position >= 0) binding.spinnerFont.setSelection(position)

        binding.spinnerFont.onItemSelectedListener = null
        binding.spinnerFont.onItemSelectedListener = object : AdapterView.OnItemSelectedListener {
            override fun onItemSelected(parent: AdapterView<*>?, view: View?, position: Int, id: Long) {
                val fontName = fonts[position]
                val oldFont = FontManager.getSelectedFont(requireContext())
                if (fontName != oldFont) {
                    AlertDialog.Builder(requireContext())
                        .setTitle("Смена шрифта")
                        .setMessage("Применить шрифт \"$fontName\" ко всем экранам? Приложение будет перезапущено.")
                        .setPositiveButton("Да") { _, _ ->
                            FontManager.setSelectedFont(requireContext(), fontName)
                            requireActivity().recreate()
                        }
                        .setNegativeButton("Отмена") { _, _ ->
                            val oldPos = fonts.indexOf(oldFont)
                            if (oldPos >= 0) binding.spinnerFont.setSelection(oldPos)
                        }
                        .show()
                }
            }
            override fun onNothingSelected(parent: AdapterView<*>?) {}
        }
    }

    override fun onDestroyView() {
        super.onDestroyView()
        _binding = null
    }
}

package com.myapp.adventure.ui

import android.Manifest
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.graphics.Color
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment
import androidx.lifecycle.lifecycleScope
import com.myapp.adventure.R
import com.myapp.adventure.data.StepBucket
import com.myapp.adventure.databinding.FragmentStatisticsBinding
import com.myapp.adventure.databinding.ItemStatsDayBinding
import com.myapp.adventure.utils.FontManager
import com.myapp.adventure.utils.StepHistoryManager
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import java.text.NumberFormat
import java.time.LocalDate
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter
import java.time.format.FormatStyle
import java.time.format.TextStyle
import java.util.Locale

class StatisticsFragment : Fragment() {

    private var _binding: FragmentStatisticsBinding? = null
    private val binding get() = _binding!!

    /** First rank threshold (visual only; actual reward logic is future). */
    private val firstRankThreshold: Long = 100_000L

    /** Cached number formatter, recreated if locale changes between onViewCreated calls. */
    private var numberFormat: NumberFormat = NumberFormat.getIntegerInstance(Locale.getDefault())

    override fun onCreateView(
        inflater: LayoutInflater,
        container: ViewGroup?,
        savedInstanceState: Bundle?
    ): View {
        _binding = FragmentStatisticsBinding.inflate(inflater, container, false)
        return binding.root
    }

    override fun onViewCreated(view: View, savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState)

        val fontName = FontManager.getSelectedFont(requireContext())
        FontManager.applyFontToViewTree(view, fontName, requireContext())

        numberFormat = NumberFormat.getIntegerInstance(Locale.getDefault())

        binding.btnMenu.setOnClickListener {
            parentFragmentManager.beginTransaction()
                .replace(R.id.fragment_container, MenuFragment())
                .addToBackStack(null)
                .commit()
        }

        loadStats()
    }

    // ==================== Loading ====================

    private fun loadStats() {
        if (_binding == null) return
        binding.tvLoading.visibility = View.VISIBLE

        viewLifecycleOwner.lifecycleScope.launch {
            val data = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                val ctx = requireContext().applicationContext
                StatisticsData(
                    total = StepHistoryManager.getTotalSteps(ctx),
                    today = StepHistoryManager.getTodaySteps(ctx),
                    last7 = StepHistoryManager.getLastNDaysSum(ctx, 7),
                    last30 = StepHistoryManager.getLastNDaysSum(ctx, 30),
                    days = StepHistoryManager.getDailyBuckets(ctx, 14)
                )
            }
            if (_binding == null) return@launch
            binding.tvLoading.visibility = View.GONE
            render(data)
        }
    }

    private data class StatisticsData(
        val total: Long,
        val today: Int,
        val last7: Int,
        val last30: Int,
        val days: List<StepBucket>
    )

    // ==================== Render ====================

    private fun render(data: StatisticsData) {
        if (_binding == null) return

        val hasPermission = hasActivityRecognitionPermission()

        // 1. No permission warning
        binding.tvNoPermission.visibility = if (!hasPermission) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE

        // 2. No data placeholder
        val hasData = data.total > 0L || data.days.any { it.steps > 0 }
        binding.tvNoData.visibility = if (!hasData) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE

        // 3. Summary / recent / days sections only when there's data
        val sectionsVisibility = if (hasData) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
        binding.sectionSummary.visibility = sectionsVisibility
        binding.sectionRecent.visibility = sectionsVisibility
        binding.sectionDays.visibility = sectionsVisibility

        if (!hasData) return

        // Total
        binding.tvTotalSteps.text = formatSteps(data.total)

        // Rank progress (visual only for now)
        renderRankProgress(data.total)

        // Today / 7 / 30
        binding.tvTodaySteps.text =
            "${getString(R.string.stats_today)}: ${formatSteps(data.today.toLong())}"
        binding.tvLast7DaysSteps.text =
            "${getString(R.string.stats_last_7_days)}: ${formatSteps(data.last7.toLong())}"
        binding.tvLast30DaysSteps.text =
            "${getString(R.string.stats_last_30_days)}: ${formatSteps(data.last30.toLong())}"

        // 14-day list
        renderDays(data.days)
    }

    private fun renderRankProgress(total: Long) {
        val threshold = firstRankThreshold
        val progress: Int
        val progressText: String
        if (total >= threshold) {
            progress = 100
            progressText = getString(
                R.string.stats_rank_achieved,
                getString(R.string.stats_rank_beginner)
            )
            binding.tvRankProgress.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#4CAF50"))
        } else {
            progress = ((total * 100L) / threshold).toInt().coerceIn(0, 100)
            progressText = getString(
                R.string.stats_rank_progress,
                progress,
                getString(R.string.stats_rank_beginner)
            )
            binding.tvRankProgress.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#FFC107"))
        }
        binding.progressRank.progress = progress
        binding.tvRankProgress.text = progressText
    }

    private fun renderDays(days: List<StepBucket>) {
        binding.containerDays.removeAllViews()

        val today = LocalDate.now()
        val dateFormatter = DateTimeFormatter
            .ofLocalizedDate(FormatStyle.MEDIUM)
            .withLocale(Locale.getDefault())
        val locale = Locale.getDefault()

        // Oldest at the top, newest at the bottom (matches reading order of a timeline).
        for (bucket in days) {
            val date = try {
                LocalDate.parse(bucket.date)
            } catch (_: Exception) {
                continue
            }

            val row = ItemStatsDayBinding.inflate(
                LayoutInflater.from(requireContext()),
                binding.containerDays,
                false
            )

            val dayOfWeek = date.dayOfWeek.getDisplayName(TextStyle.SHORT, locale)
            val isToday = date == today
            val dateLabel = if (isToday) {
                "${dateFormatter.format(date)} · ${getString(R.string.stats_today).lowercase(locale)}"
            } else {
                "$dayOfWeek, ${dateFormatter.format(date)}"
            }

            row.tvDayLabel.text = dateLabel
            row.tvDaySteps.text = formatSteps(bucket.steps.toLong())
            // Dim days with zero steps so they don't dominate the screen.
            row.tvDaySteps.setTextColor(
                if (bucket.steps == 0) Color.parseColor("#666666")
                else Color.parseColor("#FFC107")
            )

            binding.containerDays.addView(row.root)
        }
    }

    // ==================== Helpers ====================

    private fun formatSteps(value: Long): String {
        val formattedNumber = numberFormat.format(value)
        // Use plurals with the raw count so Android picks the right form.
        val stepsText = resources.getQuantityString(
            R.plurals.steps,
            value.toInt(),
            value.toInt()
        )
        // We only want the plural form word ("шаг"/"шага"/"шагов"), not the formatted number.
        // The plural string starts with "%d" — strip it.
        val suffix = stepsText.replace(value.toString(), "").trim()
        return "$formattedNumber $suffix"
    }

    private fun hasActivityRecognitionPermission(): Boolean {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) return true
        return ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(
            requireContext(),
            Manifest.permission.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION
        ) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
    }

    override fun onDestroyView() {
        super.onDestroyView()
        _binding = null
    }
}
